---
title: "MacroSignals — Vintage-Aware Macro Signal Research"
subtitle: "Run-level research report"
date: "`r format(as.Date(params$as_of), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    self_contained: true
    code_folding: hide
params:
  run_id: "run_20261113_demo"
  params_path: "config/params.yml"
  results_dir: "results"
  db_path: "data/macrosignals.sqlite"
  as_of: "2026-11-13"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4.8, dpi = 110)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
})

root <- normalizePath(".")
if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "DESCRIPTION"))) {
  stop("Report must be knitted from the MacroSignals project root.")
}
for (f in list.files(file.path(root, "R"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  source(f)
}

params_yaml <- load_params(params$params_path)
hash <- params_hash(params$params_path)
results_dir <- params$results_dir
db_path <- params$db_path
run_id <- params$run_id

metrics <- readr::read_csv(file.path(results_dir, "metrics.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
curves <- readr::read_csv(file.path(results_dir, "equity_curve.csv"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
sens <- readr::read_csv(file.path(results_dir, "cost_sensitivity.csv"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE)
ranked <- readr::read_csv(file.path(results_dir, "ranked_latest.csv"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE)

con <- db_connect(db_path)
series_meta <- db_query(con, "SELECT * FROM series_meta ORDER BY series_id")
instrument_meta <- db_query(con, "SELECT * FROM instrument_meta
                                  ORDER BY asset_class, instrument_id")
observations <- db_query(
  con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(obs_date) AS first_obs,
               MAX(obs_date) AS last_obs, COUNT(DISTINCT series_id) AS series
          FROM observations")
price_stats <- db_query(
  con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(obs_date) AS first_px,
               MAX(obs_date) AS last_px, COUNT(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments
          FROM prices")
validation <- db_query(
  con, "SELECT * FROM validation_log WHERE run_id = ? ORDER BY check_name, series_id",
  list(run_id))
signal_values <- db_query(
  con, "SELECT * FROM signal_values WHERE run_id = ? ORDER BY as_of_date,
               instrument_id", list(run_id))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

check_counts <- validation %>%
  count(check_name, severity, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(check_name)
fails <- sum(validation$severity == "fail")
status_label <- if (fails == 0) "PASS — publication allowed" else
  paste0("FAIL — ", fails, " blocking checks")
status_colour <- if (fails == 0) "#1a7f37" else "#b42318"

net <- metrics %>% filter(basis == "net")
gross <- metrics %>% filter(basis == "gross")
fmt_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * x)
fmt_num <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
```

<div style="padding:10px 14px;margin:8px 0 18px 0;border-left:6px solid `r status_colour`;
background:#f7f7f7;font-size:1.05em;">
<strong>Data-quality gate:</strong>
<span style="color:`r status_colour`;font-weight:700;">`r status_label`</span><br/>
Run <code>`r run_id`</code> · as of `r params$as_of` · params hash
<code>`r substr(hash, 1, 12)`</code>
</div>

# Universe and data coverage

The committed research universe contains **`r nrow(instrument_meta)` instruments**
across **`r length(unique(instrument_meta$asset_class))` asset classes** and
**`r nrow(series_meta)` vintage-aware macro series**. The price panel covers
`r price_stats$first_px` to `r price_stats$last_px` with
`r format(price_stats$n, big.mark = ",")` instrument-days. The vintage store
holds `r format(observations$n, big.mark = ",")` observation-vintage rows from
`r observations$first_obs` to `r observations$last_obs`.

```{r universe-table}
instrument_meta %>%
  count(asset_class, name = "instruments") %>%
  kable(caption = "Instrument coverage by asset class")
```

```{r macro-table}
series_meta %>%
  select(series_id, name, country, frequency, unit, publish_lag_days) %>%
  kable(caption = "Macro series and publication lags")
```

# Validation summary

Each named check is run against the point-in-time view at the as-of date.
Any `fail` blocks signal publication. This run recorded
**`r nrow(validation)` validation rows**, **`r fails` FAIL rows**.

```{r validation-summary}
if (nrow(check_counts) == 0) {
  data.frame(check_name = "all checks", severity = "pass", n = 0) %>%
    kable(caption = "Validation checks (no findings)")
} else {
  check_counts %>% kable(caption = "Validation findings by check and severity")
}
```

```{r validation-detail}
if (nrow(validation) > 0) {
  validation %>%
    select(series_id, check_name, severity, message) %>%
    kable(caption = "Validation log for this run")
} else {
  cat("No validation findings: all six checks passed cleanly.")
}
```

# Signal distributions

Cross-sectional z-scores for the four published signals at every rebalance
date. Winsorisation is applied at the
`r params_yaml$zscore$winsor_level` level before standardisation.

```{r signal-dist, fig.height=5.2}
signal_values %>%
  filter(is.finite(zscore)) %>%
  mutate(signal_name = factor(signal_name,
    levels = c("carry", "momentum", "macro_surprise", "composite"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = zscore, fill = signal_name)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.55, colour = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~signal_name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Cross-sectional z-score", y = "Density", fill = NULL,
       title = "Signal distributions across rebalance dates") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Equity curves

Net-of-cost cumulative PnL for each signal, with the configured one-way cost of
`r params_yaml$cost_bp` bp on traded notional.

```{r equity-curves}
curves %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cum_net, colour = signal_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cumulative net growth of 1",
       colour = NULL, title = "Net equity curves") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Drawdowns

```{r drawdowns}
curves %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = drawdown_net, colour = signal_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.65) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Drawdown", colour = NULL,
       title = "Net drawdowns from running peak") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Performance and risk

Gross and net diagnostics. Max drawdown is reported with the peak-to-trough
date range; turnover is annualised traded notional; holding period is the mean
run length of a non-zero position in business days.

```{r metrics-table}
net %>%
  transmute(
    Signal = signal_name,
    `Ann. return` = fmt_pct(ann_return),
    `Ann. vol` = fmt_pct(ann_vol),
    Sharpe = fmt_num(sharpe),
    `Max DD` = fmt_pct(max_dd),
    `DD period` = paste0(dd_start, " → ", dd_end),
    Calmar = fmt_num(calmar),
    `Hit rate` = fmt_pct(hit_rate),
    `Ann. turnover` = fmt_num(ann_turnover),
    `Holding days` = fmt_num(avg_holding_days, 1)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = paste0("Net-of-cost metrics (", params_yaml$cost_bp, " bp)"))
```

```{r gross-table}
gross %>%
  transmute(
    Signal = signal_name,
    `Ann. return` = fmt_pct(ann_return),
    `Ann. vol` = fmt_pct(ann_vol),
    Sharpe = fmt_num(sharpe),
    `Max DD` = fmt_pct(max_dd),
    Calmar = fmt_num(calmar),
    `Ann. turnover` = fmt_num(ann_turnover)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Gross (zero-cost) metrics")
```

# Turnover and cost sensitivity

The grid reruns each strategy at one-way costs of
`r paste(params_yaml$cost_grid_bp, collapse = ", ")` bp. Net Sharpe is shown for
the composite and each stand-alone signal.

```{r cost-sensitivity}
sens %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cost_bp, y = sharpe, colour = signal_name, group = signal_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  labs(x = "One-way cost (bp)", y = "Net Sharpe", colour = NULL,
       title = "Net Sharpe versus transaction cost") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r cost-table}
sens %>%
  select(signal_name, cost_bp, ann_return, sharpe, ann_turnover) %>%
  mutate(across(c(ann_return), fmt_pct),
         across(c(sharpe, ann_turnover), fmt_num)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cost_bp,
                     values_from = c(ann_return, sharpe, ann_turnover),
                     names_glue = "{.value}_{cost_bp}bp") %>%
  kable(caption = "Cost-sensitivity grid (net)")
```

# Latest ranked cross-section

Rank 1 is the most attractive composite signal at the final rebalance date.

```{r ranked-table}
ranked %>%
  transmute(
    Rank = rank, Instrument = instrument_id, Name = name, Class = asset_class,
    Carry = fmt_num(carry_z), Momentum = fmt_num(momentum_z),
    `Macro surprise` = fmt_num(macro_surprise_z),
    Composite = fmt_num(composite_z)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = paste("Ranked signals as of", unique(ranked$as_of_date)))
```

# Reproducibility

Every number in this report was produced by `scripts/run_research.R` from the
seeded deterministic fixtures. The parameter file is version controlled and its
MD5 is recorded in the run summary.

```{r reproducibility}
cat("Run id           :", run_id, "\n")
cat("As-of date       :", params$as_of, "\n")
cat("Params file      :", params$params_path, "\n")
cat("Params MD5       :", hash, "\n")
cat("Fixture seed     :", params_yaml$seed, "\n")
cat("R version        :", R.version.string, "\n")
cat("Platform         :", R.version$platform, "\n")
cat("Rebalance        :", params_yaml$rebalance, "\n")
cat("Cost (bp)        :", params_yaml$cost_bp, "\n")
cat("Validation checks:", nrow(check_counts), "distinct findings;",
    fails, "FAIL rows\n")
```

```{r params-dump}
flat <- function(x, prefix = "") {
  if (is.list(x)) {
    out <- unlist(lapply(names(x), function(nm) {
      flat(x[[nm]], if (nzchar(prefix)) paste0(prefix, ".", nm) else nm)
    }))
    return(out)
  }
  if (length(x) > 1) {
    return(stats::setNames(paste(x, collapse = ", "), prefix))
  }
  stats::setNames(as.character(x), prefix)
}
p <- flat(params_yaml)
data.frame(parameter = names(p), value = unname(p)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Version-controlled parameters")
```
